How these numbers are made: pageviews only; no cookies, no IP addresses; visitors are de-duplicated per day by a one-way fingerprint that cannot be linked across days; bots and DNT/GPC requests are dropped; country comes from Cloudflare's edge and is country-level only.

Birds of Zhuhai

A field guide to the birds of southern China, with a focus on the Pearl River Delta and Zhuhai.
65 species you stand a real chance of meeting here, with identification notes and field recordings.

Photographs and recordings come from Wikimedia Commons and iNaturalist under their respective open licences. Every species page credits the author and licence.
